draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 34th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 3rd of 30 at LB. He went 54th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: George Karlaftis. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 46 tackles in 2022, 24th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Los Angeles Chargers. 50 career games and 36 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (11 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 20 (99th percentile), sacks 13.0 (96th percentile), approximate value 11 (94th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 edge rusher who played: 13.0 sacks against a median of 2.0, above the norm.
